electricity_costs_method.info: Source of energy prices and relevant peak for capacity charge: fixed_wo_plw, fixed_w_plw, variable_wo_plw, variable_w_plw

energy_charges.info: Procurement, commodity (and virtual for variable_*) costs, levies, concession fee and electricity tax per kWh, annualized, net (without VAT)

capacity_charge.info: capacity_charge_EUR/kW*a (RLM only); peak inside peak load windows for *_w_plw, overall peak otherwise

grid_connection.info: Power dependent capex of grid connection and transformer (per kW / lifetime) incl. transformer maintenance

feed_in_remuneration.info: Remuneration for feed-in (PV, V2G, stationary storage) as negative costs

stationary_storage_sizing.info: Optimize capacity of stationary storage: capex_per_kWh / lifetime + maintenance. capex_fix is not part of the optimization (would need a MILP), but is included in the cost calculation afterwards

stationary_storage_balanced.info: Stationary storage content at the end of the simulation equals the initial content
